More St. Moritz Park
St. Moritz Park is already a favourite place for many, and with your help, we’re going to make it even better. We want to learn from you how we can renew this much-loved park for everyone to enjoy. What ideas do you have for the future of the park? Let’s grow together!
We’re looking to add new features to better serve our growing community. We want to bring you more play, more connection, more opportunities for e
veryone. More St. Moritz Park.
About St. Moritz park
St. Moritz Park is situated at 516 St Moritz Ave, beside Edna Staebler Public School, and covers a large area of 3.89 hectares with a hydro corridor running through it. Currently, the park includes: a community garden; tennis court; informal soccer field; connecting trails; community rink; seating; as well as a stormwater management pond and naturalized areas.
